english.title: Fail to notify the Secretary of State of the suspected presence of a TSE in the carcase of an animal and retain it
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), having examined the carcase of

(A)_[an animal]_
(B)_[animals]_

in a laboratory, failed to notify the Secretary of State of your suspicion of the presence of a TSE and to retain the carcase until a veterinary inspector had authorised disposal
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 5(3) and 18(1)(a) of the Transmissible Spongiform Encephalopathies (England) Regulations 2018.
